description: Shared-encoder two-head student (gte-modernbert-base, CLS, one Linear(768,6): col0 toxic logit, cols1-5 toxicity softmax), fp32 ONNX. Trained 3 epochs (lr 3e-5, bs 32, max_len 64) on soft labels for 8,675 pool texts from deepseek-v4.1-flash with labeling guidance v1 (P(toxic)+5-level distribution in one call), mixed 2:1 with v1 silver hard labels (plain+seeded) where available; uniform weight soup of 3 seeds. toxic = E[toxicity]/4 >= 0.30 (threshold = max of 7-pt smoothed dev accuracy curve; E[toxicity] beat the toxic head on dev threshold-CV accuracy across 5 runs, 0.896 vs 0.877). int8 rejected (dev AUROC 0.960->0.940, Spearman 0.769->0.729).

dev_metrics.note: dev was used for threshold and config choice, so these are optimistic
